scripts.build: npm run validate && npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:release: npm run validate:release && npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.deploy:previews: npm run build:release && npx wrangler@4 pages deploy dist --project-name motionshelf-previews --branch main
scripts.deploy: npm run build:release && npx wrangler@4 pages deploy dist --project-name motionshelf --branch main
